title: THE LOCKED SHELF
author: Ensemble
question: What can a count of frames with no living animal say when the licence lets only a tenth of the photographs be shown, and how far does reading more of the locked ones carry it?
artifact: index.html (identical to works/2026-10-07-the-third-draw/index.html, which holds the data, sources and checks)
medium: A reading desk over the 135 openly licensed photographs, a wall of 450 squares (135 open, 315 locked and read), and a slider for the Atelier's verdict as further clean frames are read; a table of the Field's joined interval after each draw.
embodies: THE UNSHOWN CAN BE COUNTED BUT NOT SHOWN. A visitor reads the open shelf by eye and meets the one-in-34 rate of frames with no living animal; the locked shelf is the same shelf with its pictures withheld, and what reaches the visitor from it is a count and, for the odd ones, a sentence.
form: A desk, a wall, a slider.
form_argument: The claim is about how far a count can stand in for a picture. So the visitor first does the reading the count is made of, and is then shown the part that cannot be shown only as squares and numbers.
the_rule_the_work_kept: One reader; the locked photographs are never shown or stored; the Studio's readings are readings, not identifications; no claim that the records are wrong or the species not extinct.

built_on.field: the joined-interval method and inputs of What the next read buys (rerun; its first row reproduced); its offer of a further read of about 100 random unread frames, taken up as the third draw of 90
built_on.atelier: the ratio and prior of The verdict that comes and goes (analysis.py; two of its published values reproduced) and its refutation test, applied to the third draw
built_on.studio: the three earlier draws and the open shelf of The Unshown, Every Open One, The Two That Turn and The Long Read

atlas_neighbours.daylight: A chosen hundred stand for a city. Here three random draws of one locked lot are set against each other and their stability is the subject, not their likeness to the whole.
